text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"more controlled sentence boundaries and fewer fragmentary errors","quality":"sentence control","description":"This captures the ability to form complete, readable sentences with fewer run-on or fragment-like breaks."},{"evidence":"broader set of developed reasons with examples from school, shopping, communication, and emergencies","quality":"idea development","description":"This captures how fully an essay expands its main point with multiple supporting ideas and examples."},{"evidence":"more varied transitions like \"Furthermore,\" \"Lastly,\" and \"In conclusion,\"","quality":"organizational control","description":"This captures clearer paragraph-to-paragraph progression and smoother linkage of ideas."},{"evidence":"fewer confusing word-choice slips such as \"one of the reasons were\" and \"use technology as a tool\"","quality":"lexical control","description":"This captures more accurate and appropriate vocabulary use in expressing ideas."},{"evidence":"more consistent subject-verb and plural agreement overall","quality":"grammatical accuracy","description":"This captures stronger control of basic English grammar rules such as agreement and verb forms."}]}
